# C07 design: Transcode, HLS and secure playback

Covers MATCH06, NFR03, NFR17, NFR25 and NFR31, plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 on every surface. Builds on C06 (`docs/build/design/C06.md`, Surfaces 5 and 6). C08 adds the real "Finding events" step; C11 puts the player in the dark review workspace.

Surfaces:

1. `HlsPlayer` component: `web/src/components/video/HlsPlayer.tsx`
2. Processing status panel on the match detail page: `/matches/[matchId]`, inside the Footage card
3. Watch section on the match detail page: `/matches/[matchId]`
4. Marker tool video pane swapped to `HlsPlayer`: `/matches/[matchId]/markers`

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **Earlier rules still apply (D01, D02, C01 to C06).** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-2`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps` and are `aria-hidden`. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule (2px `focus`, 2px offset).
- **Theme.** No C07 surface is forced dark. The player follows the page theme. One exception: while the player is in full screen, the player root gets `data-theme="dark"` (the same mechanism as `ThemeScope`), so the controls read against a black screen. C11 wraps the player in its dark `Workspace`; the player needs nothing extra for that.
- **Roles.** Pages: `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Playback routes: `withRole(MATCH_ROLES)`. Scouts and other roles go to `/forbidden` (C01 copy). Another organisation's match is `notFound()` on pages and 404 on routes.
- **Children's data.** The player never shows or stores player names. Its accessible name uses the fixture (team names) only. Nothing goes to `localStorage`, including the chosen quality.
- **Times.** Video positions use `formatVideoTime(ms, 0)` (**47:12**; minutes not capped at 59: **112:31**), in `data` with `tabular-nums`. The marker tool keeps one decimal in its own readout (C06).
- **Motion.** Hover and toggle changes 150ms ease-out; the quality menu opens with no animation. Nothing spins: `LoaderCircle` is static, as in `MATCH_STATES`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, the seek fill has no transition.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, *match*, *pitch*, *kickoff*, *half-time*, *full time*. No exclamation marks, no emoji. Never show technical error text (ffmpeg output, `errorMessage`, HTTP codes) to a club user.

### CSS: append a C07 block to `web/src/styles/components.css`

Header comment: `/* Video player and processing panel for C07 (docs/build/design/C07.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`

| Class | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-player` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--surface-sunken); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden;` The root and the full-screen element. |
| `.wl-player:fullscreen` | `border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface-sunken);` (dark theme is set by `data-theme`). The screen takes `flex: 1`; the controls stay at the bottom. |
| `.wl-player__screen` | `position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--surface-sunken);` Holds the `<video>` (`width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; display: block`), the skeleton, the buffering note and the message panel. In full screen: `aspect-ratio: auto; flex: 1; min-height: 0`. |
| `.wl-player__status` | The buffering note: `position: absolute; inset: auto auto var(--space-3) var(--space-3); display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-1); align-items: center; padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);` Icon 16px. |
| `.wl-player__message` | The error panel: `position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-4); text-align: center; background: var(--surface-sunken); color: var(--ink);` Icon 20px; `danger` for errors, `warning` for "cannot play". |
| `.wl-player__controls` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3) var(--space-3); background: var(--surface-raised); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);` |
| `.wl-player__bar` | The button row: `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1);` From 768px `gap: var(--space-2)`. |
| `.wl-player__time` | `margin-inline: var(--space-2); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink);` Markup adds `.data`. Then a spacer: `.wl-player__spacer { flex: 1; }`. |
| `.wl-player__seek` | `appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 44px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;` Track (both `::-webkit-slider-runnable-track` and `::-moz-range-track`): `height: var(--space-1); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--pitch) var(--wl-seek, 0%), var(--line-strong) var(--wl-seek, 0%));` `--wl-seek` is data, set inline from currentTime / duration, as `--wl-progress` in C06. Thumb: `width: var(--space-4); height: var(--space-4); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--pitch); border: 2px solid var(--surface-raised); margin-top: calc((var(--space-1) - var(--space-4)) / 2);` Focus: `outline: none` on the input, and `:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb` / `::-moz-range-thumb` get `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px`. Disabled: `cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45`. |
| `.wl-player__btn` | Added to `.wl-iconbtn` for the bar's icon buttons: `border-color: transparent; background: transparent;` Hover `background: var(--surface-sunken)`. `[aria-pressed="true"]`: `background: var(--pitch-soft); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--pitch);` (pressed has fill, bar and the state in the label, never colour alone). Size stays from `.wl-iconbtn` (36px from 768px, 44px under 768px). |
| `.wl-player__quality` | The quality trigger: `.wl-btn.wl-btn--ghost.wl-btn--sm` with an icon and the current level as text. Under 768px the text is visually hidden (`.sr-only` on the text span) and the button is 44px square. |
| `.wl-player__menu` | Added to `.wl-popover`: `bottom: calc(100% + var(--space-1)); right: 0; top: auto; min-width: calc(var(--space-12) * 4);` The wrapper `.wl-player__menuwrap { position: relative; }`. In full screen the popover stays inside the player element (it is a child of it). |
| `.wl-checklist [data-state="failed"] svg` | `color: var(--danger)`. `[data-state="retrying"] svg`: `color: var(--warning)`. `[data-state="done"] svg` is the existing `[data-done="true"]` rule (pitch); use `data-done="true"` for done rows. |

`wl-player__seek` keeps a 44px hit area at every width. All bar buttons are at least 44px under 768px (NFR24, design system "touch targets").

## Surface 1: `HlsPlayer`, `web/src/components/video/HlsPlayer.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins on the match page and in the marker tool, on a laptop or a phone (C07). Scouts in the review workspace, often on a phone on the sideline (C11). One job: play private match footage smoothly with full keyboard control, captions when there are any, and a precise time readout (MATCH06, NFR03, NFR25).

**Not in the design system.** It is a new component, built from `surface-sunken`, `surface-raised`, `line`, `line-strong`, `ink`, `pitch`, `pitch-soft`, `focus`, `danger`, `warning`, `radius-md`, `radius-sm`, `radius-pill` (slider thumb only, as a toggle-like control), `shadow-pop` (quality menu only) and the `space-*` steps. It reuses `.wl-iconbtn`, `.wl-btn--ghost`, `.wl-popover`, `Skeleton shape="video"` and `Button`.

### Props (as the plan) plus one

- `source`, `captions?`, `title`, `keyboard?: "own" | "host"` (default `"own"`), `onTimeUpdate?(ms)`, ref handle `{ play, pause, toggle, seekTo(ms), seekBy(ms), currentMs }`.
- Add `onStateChange?(state: "loading" | "ready" | "cannot_play" | "failed")`. The marker tool needs it to hide its Set buttons when the video cannot play.
- `title` is the accessible name of the group: **Match video: {fixtureText}** on the match page, **Match video** in the marker tool (its page heading already names the match).

### Structure (DOM order)

```
div.wl-player  role="group"  aria-label={title}  aria-roledescription="video player"
  div.wl-player__screen
    video  playsInline  preload="metadata"  (no controls attribute; no autoplay)
      track kind="captions" … (one per captions prop)
    Skeleton shape="video"           (loading only)
    div.wl-player__status            (buffering only)
    div.wl-player__message           (error states only)
  div.wl-player__controls
    input.wl-player__seek  type="range"
    div.wl-player__bar
      Play / Pause        IconButton.wl-player__btn
      Mute                IconButton.wl-player__btn
      span.wl-player__time.data
      span.wl-player__spacer
      Captions            IconButton.wl-player__btn     (only with tracks)
      Quality             div.wl-player__menuwrap > button.wl-player__quality + div.wl-popover.wl-player__menu
      Full screen         IconButton.wl-player__btn     (only when supported)
  span.sr-only  aria-live="polite"   (announcements)
```

The `<video>` element itself is not in the tab order (`tabIndex={-1}`). A click or tap on the screen toggles play and pause. A double click toggles full screen (mouse only).

### Elements, tokens and copy

| Element | Component and tokens | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Screen | `.wl-player__screen` on `surface-sunken`, 16:9, letterboxed with `object-fit: contain` | none |
| Seek slider | `.wl-player__seek`; played part `pitch`, rest `line-strong`; thumb `pitch` with a `surface-raised` ring | `aria-label` **Seek**. `aria-valuetext` **{current} of {duration}**, for example **12:34 of 92:10** (both `formatVideoTime(ms, 0)`, matching the visible time; this replaces the plan's `1:32:10` form, since C06 never shows hours). `min=0`, `max` = duration in seconds, `step=1`. |
| Play | `IconButton` + `.wl-player__btn`, `Play` / `Pause` icon | `aria-label` **Play** / **Pause**; `title` **Play (K)** / **Pause (K)** in own mode, **Play** / **Pause** in host mode |
| Mute | `IconButton` + `.wl-player__btn`, `Volume2` / `VolumeX`, `aria-pressed` when muted | `aria-label` **Mute**; `title` **Mute (M)** in own mode |
| Time | `span.data.wl-player__time` in `ink` | **{current} / {duration}**, for example **12:34 / 92:10**, **112:31 / 118:02**. Before metadata: **0:00 / 0:00**. |
| Captions | `IconButton` + `.wl-player__btn`, `Captions` icon, `aria-pressed` when on | `aria-label` **Captions**; `title` **Captions (C)**. With two or more tracks it opens a menu like Quality: heading **Captions**, items **Off** then each track `label`. |
| Quality | `.wl-player__quality` (`wl-btn--ghost wl-btn--sm`), `Settings2` icon, text = current choice in `label` | Trigger text **Auto** or **1080p**, **720p**, **480p**. Accessible name **Quality: Auto** (or **Quality: 720p**). In Auto while playing, the trigger reads **Auto · 720p** from 768px. |
| Quality menu | `.wl-popover.wl-player__menu`, items `.wl-popover__item.body`, current item `aria-pressed="true"` with a `Check` icon, others with an empty 18px slot | Heading `p.wl-popover__heading.label` **Quality**. Items: **Auto**, then only the renditions the master playlist has, highest first: **1080p**, **720p**, **480p**. Under Auto, `caption text-ink-muted` **Picks the best quality for your connection.** |
| Full screen | `IconButton` + `.wl-player__btn`, `Maximize` / `Minimize` | `aria-label` **Full screen** / **Exit full screen**; `title` **Full screen (F)** in own mode |
| Buffering note | `.wl-player__status`, `LoaderCircle` static 16px, `caption` | **Loading…** |

### States

| State | What shows | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Loading (before `loadedmetadata`) | `Skeleton shape="video"` fills the screen; controls render with every control `disabled`; the root has `aria-busy="true"`; `span.sr-only` in the root | sr-only **Loading video…** |
| Ready, paused at 0 | First frame (no poster; never a decorative frame), controls enabled | Play label **Play** |
| Playing | Play shows Pause; seek fill and time update on `timeupdate` (about 4 times a second; never a live region) | none |
| Buffering (`waiting`, cleared on `playing`) | `.wl-player__status` bottom left of the screen after 500 ms (no flash on fast seeks) | **Loading…** |
| Signed URL expired (a fragment or key load answers 403, or the file source fails with a network error) | Silent: reload the source once, restore `currentTime` and paused state, no message. HLS: `hls.loadSource(url)` again (the playlist route re-signs). File: call `refresh()` for a new URL. | none |
| Failed (second network failure in a row, or a fatal hls.js error after `recoverMediaError` once) | `.wl-player__message` over the screen; `CircleAlert` in `danger`; controls disabled; `onStateChange("failed")` | `body-strong` **The video stopped loading.** `caption text-ink-muted` **Check your connection, then try again.** `Button secondary` **Try again** (reloads the source at the last position; focus moves to the Play button once ready). |
| Cannot play (no MSE and no native HLS; or a file source with `MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED` / `MEDIA_ERR_DECODE`) | `.wl-player__message`; `TriangleAlert` in `warning`; no retry; `onStateChange("cannot_play")` | `body-strong` **This browser cannot play the video.** `caption text-ink-muted` **Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.** |
| Signed out (playlist answers 401) | `.wl-player__message`; `CircleAlert` in `danger` | `body-strong` **You have been signed out.** `ButtonLink secondary` **Sign in again** to `/login?next={current path}` |
| Forbidden or gone (playlist answers 403 or 404) | `.wl-player__message`; `CircleAlert` in `danger`; no retry | `body-strong` **This video is no longer available.** `caption text-ink-muted` **It may have been deleted, or your access has changed.** |
| No captions | Captions button not rendered; C key does nothing | none |
| Captions on | Native cue rendering (`::cue` is left to the browser, so user caption settings apply) | announce **Captions on** / **Captions off** |
| Partial ladder (source under 1080p) | Quality menu lists only the renditions that exist, for example **Auto**, **720p**, **480p**; with one rendition the Quality control is not rendered | none |
| Native HLS (Safari, iOS) | Quality control not rendered (the browser picks); HLS subtitle tracks shown through `video.textTracks` | none |
| File source (marker-tool fallback) | Quality control not rendered | none |
| No audio track | Mute stays (harmless; keeps the bar stable) | none |
| Full screen not supported (iPhone Safari has no element full screen) | Use `video.webkitEnterFullscreen()` when present (the system player takes over); otherwise do not render the button | none |
| Long content | Duration over 99 min widens the time by one character; `tabular-nums` and `nowrap` stop jitter. A long `title` only affects the accessible name. | none |

Nothing autoplays. Quality and captions choices last for the page view only.

### Layout

The player fills its container's width; height follows 16:9 plus the controls.

- **375.** Seek slider on its own row, full width (44px hit area). Bar under it: Play, Mute, time, spacer, Captions (if any), Quality (icon only, 44px), Full screen. Gap `space-1`. With all five buttons and **112:31 / 118:02** the row fits 343px (5 × 44 + time + 4 × 4). `capLevelToPlayerSize` means Auto stays near 480p at this width.
- **768.** Same two rows. Bar gap `space-2`; icon buttons 36px; Quality shows icon and text.
- **1280.** Same as 768. In Auto the trigger shows **Auto · 720p**.
- **Full screen (any width).** Root `data-theme="dark"`, no radius. Screen fills the viewport above the controls. Controls stay visible (no auto-hide in v0: they never cover the picture, so nothing hides).

### Keyboard, focus and screen readers

- **Tab order:** Seek, Play, Mute, Captions, Quality, Full screen. The time is not focusable. Inside a message panel, its button comes first.
- **Own mode** (`keyboard="own"`, the match page). The root handles `keydown` from any element inside it, when no modifier key is held and the quality or captions menu is closed:

  | Key | Action |
  |---|---|
  | Space, K | Play or pause. Space is left alone when focus is on a button (the button activates natively) |
  | ← / → | Back or forward 5 s (also on the seek slider: `preventDefault` the native 1 s step) |
  | Home / End | Start / end |
  | M | Mute or unmute |
  | C | Captions on or off (only with tracks) |
  | F | Full screen or exit |

  J and L are not bound: C11 uses them for next and previous event. Keys outside the player do nothing.
- **Host mode** (`keyboard="host"`, the marker tool, C11). The player binds no keys and does not `preventDefault`. The host drives it through the ref handle. The slider keeps native arrow keys (1 s, matching the marker tool's 1 s).
- **Shortcut discoverability.** In own mode, under the player (outside it), a `details` with `summary.label` **Keyboard shortcuts** and a `dl.wl-facts`: `Kbd` Space or `Kbd` K **Play or pause**; `Kbd` ← `Kbd` → **Move 5 s**; `Kbd` Home `Kbd` End **Go to the start or the end**; `Kbd` M **Mute or unmute**; `Kbd` C **Captions on or off** (only with tracks); `Kbd` F **Full screen**. Every shortcut also has its visible button.
- **Menus.** Disclosure pattern as D02 popovers: trigger `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`; Enter, Space or click opens and moves focus to the current item; ↑ / ↓ move between items; Escape or a click outside closes and returns focus to the trigger; choosing an item closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- **Full screen.** Entering keeps focus on the Full screen button (now **Exit full screen**). Escape exits (browser). On exit, focus returns to the Full screen button.
- **Announcements** (`span.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]` in the root): **Quality set to 720p.**, **Quality set to Auto.**, **Captions on.**, **Captions off.**, **Muted.**, **Sound on.** Play, pause and seeks are not announced (the button label and slider value carry them). Errors are inside the message panel; when one appears, focus moves to its button if focus was inside the player, else it is announced through the live region with its `body-strong` sentence.
- The skeleton is `aria-hidden`. The `<video>` has no `aria-label` (the group names it).

## Surface 2: processing status panel, `/matches/[matchId]` (Footage card)

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins, on a laptop or a phone, after uploading. Design system row: "Club dashboard: matches by status". One job: show what is happening to accepted footage, whether anything went wrong, and when it will be ready (MATCH07, NFR31 surfaced as plain status).

**Data.** `processingSummary(ctx, matchId)`: the transcode `ProcessingJob` (`status`, `attempts`, `maxAttempts`, `startedAt`, `finishedAt`) or `null`; the match status; `estimatedReadyAt(video, timings)`. Never pass `errorMessage` to the page.

**When it shows.** Only when the footage is accepted and the match status is **Processing** or **Failed**. In later statuses (Awaiting review onwards) it is not rendered: the match status chip and the C06 status sentence already say where the match is.

### Structure (inside the Footage card's existing `aria-live="polite"` div)

After `FootageFacts`, before the C06 status sentence:

1. `h3.body-strong.mt-6` **Processing**
2. `ol.wl-checklist.mt-2` (reuse; `role="list"`), two steps. Each `li` has `data-done` / `data-state`, an icon (20px), then a `div` with:
   - `span.body` step name, then ` · ` and the state word in `body-strong`;
   - `p.caption.text-ink-muted` the caption.
3. The C06 status sentence (`p.body.mt-4`), unchanged: the estimated finish.

### Step 1: Preparing playback

| Job state | Icon | `data-*` | Line | Caption |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No job yet, or `queued` with `attempts = 0` | `CircleDashed` | none (`ink-muted`) | **Preparing playback · Waiting to start** | **Starts in a few minutes.** |
| `running`, attempt 1 | `LoaderCircle` (static) | none | **Preparing playback · In progress** | **Making copies of the video at three qualities, so it plays smoothly in the browser.** |
| `running`, attempt n > 1 | `LoaderCircle` | `data-state="retrying"` (`warning`) | **Preparing playback · In progress, attempt {n} of {max}** | **The first try did not finish, so we are trying again.** (attempt 3: **Earlier tries did not finish, so we are trying again.**) |
| `queued` with `attempts ≥ 1` (waiting for a retry) | `RotateCcw` | `data-state="retrying"` | **Preparing playback · Trying again soon, attempt {attempts + 1} of {max}** | **The last try did not finish. We try again in a minute.** |
| `succeeded` | `Check` | `data-done="true"` (`pitch`) | **Preparing playback · Ready** | **You can watch the match below.** |
| `failed` | `CircleAlert` | `data-state="failed"` (`danger`) | **Preparing playback · Failed** | **We tried {max} times. Wideline staff have been told and will try again.** |

### Step 2: Finding events (placeholder until C08)

| Condition | Icon | Line | Caption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Playback not ready | `CircleDashed` | **Finding events · Not started** | **Starts after playback is ready.** |
| Playback ready (C07 always stops here) | `CircleDashed` | **Finding events · Waiting to start** | **We find goals, shots and passes, then a scout checks them.** |
| Transcode failed | `CircleDashed` | **Finding events · Not started** | none |

C08 replaces step 2's rows with its own job states, in the same shape.

### Estimated finish

Keep C06's sentence and its two forms. `estimatedReadyAt` now uses measured timings when there are 5 or more samples; the copy does not change with the sample size (it already says **about**). Small sample: no extra flag, because this is an estimate, not a stat.

- Processing, estimate in the future: **Processing. Ready for review by about {formatReadyBy}.**
- Processing, estimate passed: **Processing is taking longer than usual. This page updates when it is ready.**
- Failed: **Processing failed. Wideline staff have been told and will try again.** (C06 copy; step 1's caption says the same in context.)

### States

- **Loading.** `[matchId]/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`), unchanged.
- **Empty.** No accepted footage: panel not rendered (the Footage card shows C06's copy).
- **Partial data.** Accepted footage with no `ProcessingJob` row (accepted before C07, or the enqueue is being repaired): step 1 **Waiting to start**.
- **Error.** If `processingSummary` throws, log a warning (`matchId` only) and render the panel without step rows: `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Processing status is not available right now. This page updates every 30 seconds.** The rest of the page renders.
- **Forbidden.** Page-level (C06): scouts to `/forbidden`; another organisation's match `notFound()`.
- **Long content.** Captions wrap; the icon stays top-aligned (`align-items: flex-start`).

### Layout

Same at 375, 768 and 1280: the card is `max-w-3xl` (C06), the list stacks one step per row, icon left. Nothing collapses.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- No interactive elements. The `h3` sits under the section's `h2` **Footage**.
- Every state is icon + word + caption; colour only reinforces (NFR27).
- The card's existing `aria-live="polite"` announces changes after the 30 s `StatusPoller` refresh. Only changed text is read.

## Surface 3: Watch section, `/matches/[matchId]`

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins, on a laptop or a phone. One job: watch the club's own match in the browser once it is prepared (MATCH06).

**Data.** `playableVideo(ctx, matchId)` (accepted, not deleted, `hlsManifestPath` set). Source: `{ kind: "hls", url: `/api/matches/${id}/hls/master.m3u8` }`. No captions in v0 (none generated); the prop stays empty.

### Structure

A new `DetailSection` `{ id: "watch", title: "Watch" }`, placed second: Footage, **Watch**, Lineups, Kickoff and half-time, Delete match. It sits outside the Footage card's live region.

- Ready: `HlsPlayer` with `title` **Match video: {fixtureText}** and `keyboard="own"`, full width of the content column. Under it, `details.mt-3` **Keyboard shortcuts** (Surface 1).
- Under the shortcuts, `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2`: **Only people in your club with access to matches can watch. Footage is deleted 7 days after upload.** (Leave out the second sentence once the raw footage has been deleted; C17 adds the HLS deletion.)

### States

| Condition | Content (`p.body.max-w-3xl.text-ink-muted` unless stated) |
|---|---|
| No footage, or footage not accepted yet (uploading, checking, rejected) | **You can watch the match here once the footage is accepted.** |
| Accepted, HLS not ready, transcode not failed | **Playback is ready once processing has prepared the video.** |
| Transcode failed | **Playback is not available because processing failed. Wideline staff have been told.** |
| Footage deleted (`deletedAt` set, or `hlsManifestPath` cleared by C17) | **The footage for this match has been deleted. Footage is kept for 7 days after upload.** |
| Ready | `HlsPlayer` (its own loading, error, signed-out and gone states) |
| Forbidden | Page-level, as Surface 2. The routes answer 401 / 404 if reached directly. |

When the transcode finishes during a `StatusPoller` refresh, the section switches from the message to the player. The player does not autoplay and focus does not move. Step 1's **Ready** caption, announced by the Footage card's live region, tells the user. After that the tree is stable: the `source` object is memoised on the URL string so a refresh never reloads the player.

### Layout

- **375.** Player full width inside the `space-4` gutter; controls as Surface 1. The caption wraps.
- **768.** Player full width inside the `space-6` gutter.
- **1280.** Player spans the content column (all 12 columns, inside `max-w-7xl`); no `max-w-3xl`, unlike the cards, because wide-angle footage needs the width. Messages stay `max-w-3xl`.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Section heading `h2` **Watch** (`tabIndex={-1}`, as C06 sections). Tab order: after the Footage card, the player's controls (Surface 1), then **Keyboard shortcuts**, then the Lineups section.
- Shortcuts act only while focus is inside the player.

## Surface 4: marker tool video pane, `/matches/[matchId]/markers`

**Who, where, job.** As C06 Surface 5: a coach on a laptop (a phone works, with typed times the easy path). One job: mark kickoff, half-time, second-half kickoff and full time (MATCH05). C07 only swaps the player.

**Data.** The page loader adds `hlsReady: boolean` (from `playableVideo`). Source: HLS when ready; otherwise `{ kind: "file", url, contentType, refresh }`, where `refresh` fetches `/api/matches/[matchId]/video-url` (15-minute URL, kept as the fallback while transcoding runs).

### Changes to C06 Surface 5

- The `div.wl-video` and the native `<video controls>` go. In their place: `HlsPlayer` with `title` **Match video**, `keyboard="host"`, a ref, `onTimeUpdate` driving the readout, and `onStateChange` driving `usable`.
- Delete MarkerTool's `onVideoError`, `canPlayType` probe, `refetched` state and `fetchUrl` effect; the player owns loading, re-signing and errors. Keep `fetchUrl` only as the `refresh` function.
- `togglePlay`, `seekBy` and `goTo` call `ref.current.toggle()`, `seekBy(ms)` and `seekTo(ms)`.
- The readout (**Video time** to 0.1 s, **Match clock**), the transport row (**Play** / **Pause** with `Kbd` K, **Back 1 s**, **Back 0.1 s**, **Forward 0.1 s**, **Forward 1 s**) and the **Keyboard shortcuts** details stay exactly as C06. The transport row keeps its own Play button: the marker tool's rule is that every shortcut has a visible button showing its `Kbd`, and the player's button shows no `Kbd`.
- The keydown wrapper keeps its rule "ignore text inputs", but treats `input[type="range"]` as not a text input, so K and 1 to 4 still work with the seek slider focused. ← and → on the slider are handled by the wrapper (1 s), with `preventDefault`.

### States

| Player state | Pane shows | Marker controls |
|---|---|---|
| `loading` | Player skeleton (in the player) | Set and Go to hidden; typed entry works |
| `ready` | Player, readout, transport row, shortcuts | Set and Go to shown; keys on |
| `cannot_play` (file fallback the browser cannot decode, typically a MOV) | Player hidden; C06 banner unchanged: `Banner tone="warn"` **This browser cannot play your video file. Type the times instead: play the file on your computer or camera, and note the time at each whistle.** When HLS becomes ready later, the next visit plays it. | Set, Go to and transport keys off |
| `failed` | Player hidden; C06 banner unchanged: `Banner tone="danger"` **The video stopped loading. Reload the page to carry on. Unsaved times are kept until you leave.** | as `cannot_play` |
| HLS not ready yet (file fallback playing) | Above the player, `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **Playing the original file while we prepare smoother playback.** | normal |
| Locked, no accepted footage, forbidden | C06 unchanged | C06 unchanged |

### Layout

As C06 Surface 5. The player replaces the well at the same width: 375 full width with the controls on two rows, then the readout and transport rows; 768 stacked panes; 1280 video 8 columns, markers 4.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: player (Seek, Play, Mute, Captions if any, Quality, Full screen), then the C06 order: transport Play, Back 1 s, Back 0.1 s, Forward 0.1 s, Forward 1 s, Keyboard shortcuts, the marker rows, Save markers.
- Shortcuts unchanged from C06: K, ← / → 1 s, comma and full stop 0.1 s, 1 to 4 set markers. The player's own keys (Space, M, C, F, Home, End, 5 s arrows) are off in host mode; Space activates the focused button.
- The marker announcements (**Kickoff set to 2:31.4.**) and the not-live readout stay as C06.
- Theme: page theme, not forced dark (C06). Full screen goes dark as Surface 1.

---

## Questions

- Q-028: should the player start phones on a lower quality to save mobile data? Default: **Auto**, capped to the player's size (about 480p at 375px), with no data-use note.
